test-set.name: ft-Examples3.4.3
test-set.description: XQuery Full Text - Section 3.4.3 - Examples Section 3.4.3

test-case.name: ft-3.4.3-examples-q1
test-case.description: Find out whether it is true that by searching on duty and on its synonyms you will find task.

modified.change: converted from original XQFTTS test ft-3.4.3-examples-q1

test-case.test: declare variable $input-context external; $input-context//book/content contains text "duty" using thesaurus at "http://bstore1.example.com/UsabilityThesaurus.xml" relationship "UF"

test-case.name: ft-3.4.3-examples-q2
test-case.description: Find people or its narrower terms.

modified.change: converted from original XQFTTS test ft-3.4.3-examples-q2

test-case.test: declare variable $input-context external; $input-context//books/book[./content contains text "people" using thesaurus at "http://bstore1.example.com/UsabilityThesaurus.xml" relationship "NT" at most 2 levels]

result.assert-xml:
